mission: Redesign and rewrite the foundation text-knowledge stack (identity, text anchoring, annotation, taxonomy, claims, operations, RDF interchange, agent surface) as eight lawful layers in a dependency DAG: design first, rewrite the layers bottom-up and cut consumers over as each lands, retire what they replace.

completionGate.statement: Not achieved until this goal's work ships as a PR driven to mergeable via /yeet (bun run beep yeet: repair -> verify -> publish --pr -> monitor).

phases.name: L0 identity: declared terms, one digest
L4 claims: core, stance, admission, signals
L3 and L6: taxonomy, alignments, interchange
L5 and L7: operations, agent surface, the flow

verificationCommands: bun run beep goals decisions check --slug text-knowledge-stack-rebuild
stopConditions: Required source files are missing or materially contradictory.
Any spend: purchases, paid services, quota top-ups or plan changes need the operator.
The same blocker repeats after reasonable investigation.
A retirement or rename is attempted without its row in research/consumer-census.md or without the consumer migration in the same PR: that step stops, the packet does not.
statusNote: P0 Design and grill is complete (PR #3420, merged as dcf6b16a77d). P1 (L0 identity) is in progress as a three-PR stack opened one after another: PR A foundation, PR B registry and pins, PR C bindings and the break. Base design research/2026-11-19-p1-design-registry-first.md; rulings in decisions/2026-11-19-p1-*.

opsScripts.purpose: P0 design module index: re-exports the L0 to L6 layers and the generator prototype as namespaces.
L0 identity design (@beep/identity, effect-only): TermIri, CodeId, ReleaseVersion, Namespace, Term, TermBinding, Deprecation, TermSnapshot.
L0 digest design (@beep/schema, @beep/jsonc): ContentHash and domain brands, CanonicalHashSet, mintContentHash, ActivityId and ActivityStart.
L1 design: OffsetUnit, OccurrenceId, QuoteKey, the recursive Selector, Resolution, Reanchoring, Anchored and the occurrence/v1 preimage.
L2 design: kind registry, makeAnnotationDocument with its pure checks, Generation, candidate bodies, merge, restrict, closure and typed refusals.
L3 design: SSSOM MappingSet with a typed confidence signal, OntoViolation, audit and coherence-check signatures.
L4 design: makeClaimCore, Stance, Challenge, Admission, Retraction, makeAssessments, Gate, the proposed-only record and the log checker signature.
L5 design: Operation, Activity, Association, mintActivityId, pure, compose and withActivity.
L6 design: three-case Literal, Dataset as a quad set with DatasetDigest, the OA profile and the OA import result.
Composed Arbitrary prototype that generates annotation documents satisfying the document checks through the minting preimages.
